visual_action: Donald Trump stands at a podium in what appears to be the White House East Room. He holds up a small, white architectural model, which he calls 'Lady Liberty'. He then puts it down and picks up another small model, which he calls 'Lincoln', and discusses the different sizes.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: He is the only person shown on screen and is the speaker throughout the video.

cast.name: billionaire donors
cast.evidence: The on-screen text states, 'Trump's showing off his toy models to an audience of billionaire donors'.

on_screen_text.text: Trump's showing off his toy models to an audience of billionaire donors
PRES. TRUMP GIVES REMARKS ON NEW BALLROOM

spoken_summary: Donald Trump shows off small models to an audience, identifying one as 'Lady Liberty' and another as 'Lincoln'. He awkwardly asks the audience if they have heard of 'Lady Liberty'. He then explains that the models would be of different sizes and arranges them, concluding, 'So this would be, I don't know, small, medium and large.' Notably, when he introduces the model of 'Lincoln,' the on-screen subtitle incorrectly reads 'NOW, HERE'S LADY.'
audio_music: The audio consists solely of Donald Trump's voice speaking, with natural room echo. There is no music or other sound design.
editing_pacing: The video is a single, continuous shot from a C-SPAN broadcast with added text overlays. The editing is static.
central_claim: Donald Trump behaves in a strange and childish way during a formal event, rambling while showing off 'toy models' to his donors.
intended_effect: To portray Donald Trump as unserious, awkward, and unfit for office, thereby encouraging ridicule.
